question: Name the first 5 users who have more than one role (VIP, moderator, or chatter) in the same stream.

WHERE type(r1) IN ['VIP', 'MODERATOR', 'CHATTER'] AND type(r2) IN ['VIP', 'MODERATOR', 'CHATTER'] AND type(r1) <> type(r2)
WITH u, s, COLLECT(DISTINCT type(r1)) AS roles1, COLLECT(DISTINCT type(r2)) AS roles2

WHERE SIZE(apoc.coll.toSet(allRoles)) > 1
RETURN DISTINCT u.name AS userName, s.name AS streamName, allRoles
LIMIT 5

MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language)
WHERE s.createdAt > datetime("2015-01-01T00:00:00Z")
RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(s) AS stream_count
ORDER BY stream_count DESC
LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 streams with the most chatter interactions.
cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User)
WITH s, COUNT(u) AS chatterCount
ORDER BY chatterCount DESC
LIMIT 5
RETURN s.name AS streamName, chatterCount
